study_scope: Retrospective geometry-family generalization on the existing archived two-step OpenFOAM dataset; no new CFD; seed 17 only for this capacity extension.

data.test_status: Retrospective: these cases were already inspected in earlier work; not a new blind test.
data.leakage_rule: Geometry-only descriptors and Reynolds number at inference; no CFD target supplied as model input. Normalization fitted only to training cases.

native_capacity.initialization: From scratch; GeoPT not transferred to these architectures
native_capacity.target_scaling: Pressure mean-centered per case; each target channel divided by its train-only RMS; train-only vorticity RMS.
native_capacity.loss: RMS-scaled field MSE + 0.25 training reverse-zone velocity MSE + 0.1 five-point-stencil vorticity MSE
native_capacity.validation: Full fluid clouds of all 8 validation cases at epoch 0, 1, every 20 epochs and final epoch; preserve RNG during evaluation.
native_capacity.checkpoint_selection: Best validation score, not test score
native_capacity.test_evaluation: All 19 test cases only after training
native_capacity.replay_check: A fresh process rebuilt the model and loaded selected weights; truth and mask exact, all 19 saved predictions allclose rtol=1e-5 atol=1e-6 before environment reset.
native_capacity.cancel_reason: User closed the remaining controls after confirming at least one complete large run per architecture; no new training is scheduled.

original_transolver.replay_check: Fresh-process predictions matched all 19 saved fields exactly; max absolute difference 0 before environment reset.
original_transolver.protocol_comparison_limit: Same frozen split and optimizer-update count as native suite, but sampling budget, scaling, loss, optimizer and checkpoint selection differ. Cross-protocol numerical differences do not isolate architecture.

metrics.report_aggregation: Arithmetic mean over 19 case-level metrics, not pooled field norm and not geometry-balanced report means.
metrics.velocity_error_pct: Case-level relative L2 velocity error in percent; lower is better.
metrics.pressure_error_pct: Case-level relative pressure error in percent; compare within protocol because scaling/selection differ.
metrics.vorticity_error_pct: Case-level relative vorticity error in percent; lower is better.
metrics.filtered_reverse_iou: Reverse flow defined by u < -0.01; four-connected components with at least 8 cells; intersection over union, higher is better.
metrics.reverse_velocity_error_pct: Relative velocity error on the CFD reverse-flow region u < -0.01; large percentages can reflect a small reference velocity norm.
metrics.extent_abs_error_H: Absolute reverse-flow extent error in channel-height units; lower is better. Exact archived implementation must be retained before extending this metric to new cases.
metrics.unrecovered_metric_implementation: The exact run-time metric source and per-case records for all new runs were not retained after reset; no new recomputation from weights is claimed by this release.

runtime_observed_before_reset.note: Observed versions, not a complete lockfile or a guarantee of bitwise retraining. Do not install this environment solely from this descriptive record.
